result.topic_en: Calculations on ether motion: a divergence-free flow derived from a potential with resistance coefficient $\mu = 1/w$, a minimum principle for the corresponding integral, solution of a damped equation of motion by an exponential integral, and energy/variation integrals involving velocities and displacements.

methods.what: Velocity from a potential with resistance; leads to the elliptic equation div(μ grad λ)=0
Variational (Dirichlet-type) minimum principle and its first variation
Solution of the damped equation of motion by variation of constants / exponential kernel integral
Evaluation of the kernel integral, giving terminal velocity X/a for constant force
Force balance with resistance plus incompressibility
Energy / dissipation functional involving velocity differences, curl terms, and kinetic term
